schema: CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT UNIQUE, tier TEXT, item_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE); CREATE TABLE inspections (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, inspection_date DATE, notes TEXT, item_code TEXT REFERENCES items (item_code));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.title FROM items AS T1 INNER JOIN inspections AS T2 ON T1.item_code = T2.item_code WHERE T1.tier = 'rare' ORDER BY T2.inspection_date DESC, T1.title ASC LIMIT 3
